_schema: talent: id zh en tier text stat? root? life? stone? cards? techs? items? cult_mult? notice_rate? hp_pct? flags unlock? note?  (flags carries the talent's own id so req.flags works)

talents.text: A hide like boiled leather: Body +1 and 15% more max HP.
You are up before the roosters: cultivation +8%, and Greet the Sun in your deck.
You count everything twice: +30 stones and an extra Odd Jobs card.
You wake at the first footstep: Notice grows 15% slower and Speed +1.
Someone taught you to look after yourself: 10% more max HP and an extra Rest card.
You read everything, including the labels: Insight +1, a worn primer, and Comprehend the Text in your deck.
Dense and slow: Body +2, Speed -1.
Strings of chance tangle themselves round your fingers: Fortune +2 and a three-coin string.
You see the seam in things: Spirit +2, and options only the perceptive can read stay open to you.
A promise you made before you could speak it: Dao-heart +2.
Born running: Speed +2 and you know Swift Step.
Plants lean toward you: a Wood root of 1 and a better Gather Herbs card.
You were cradled by a bellows: Body +1, a Fire root of 1 and Hammer and Ore in your deck.
A mind that sees the lesson before the teacher: Insight +3, but two terms less of life. Brilliant lives burn short.
A page you once read is still open somewhere behind your eyes: Dao-heart +1, and the first term already knows one of your truths.
talents.note: Unlocks once you have found any truth (the first one, Your name is not in the Registry, opens it).

talents.text: A bone like a blade: a Metal root of 4, Speed +1 and you know Azure Slash.
Fists first, questions later: Body +2, Spirit +1, 10% more max HP, and you know Iron Fist.
Somebody up there likes the look of you: Fortune +3 and +40 stones.
talents.note: Unlocks when you buy A Lucky Star on the Wheel.

talents.text: The Wheel's spokes left a groove in you: cultivation +20% and two more terms of life.
talents.note: Unlocks when you learn the Wheel's truth (The Wheel was built to recycle failed patches).

talents.text: You have the Registry's own pen-hold: Insight +2, Dao-heart +1, and Notice grows 30% slower.
talents.note: Unlocks after you have met the Magistrate.

talents.text: You know what the sky is made of, and it has stopped being able to frighten you: Dao-heart +4, Notice grows 20% slower, one less term of life.
talents.note: Unlocks when you learn that Ascension is filing.

talents.text: A frame the sky approves of: every stat +1 and two more terms of life.
The sky is a thing you have already done once: Body +3, Spirit +2, but Notice grows 25% faster.
You have written something nobody wrote before: Insight +2, Fortune +2, Dao-heart +2, and cultivation +10%.
talents.note: Unlocks after The Blank Writ ending.

talents.text: Someone, somewhere, kept a stove lit: six more terms of life, 60 stones and 15% more max HP.
talents.note: Unlocks after the Mortal Dust ending.

talents.text: A cold seed under the breastbone: Spirit +4 and cultivation +30%, but Dao-heart -2.
talents.note: Unlocks after the Nine Netherworlds ending.
